name: gin_fuzzy_search_limit
description: Sets a soft upper limit on the number of rows returned by GIN index fuzzy search scans.
symptoms: Premature truncation of search result sets
Poor recall in full-text or trigram-based searches
Unexpected empty or sparse results for broad queries
tuning_tips: Increase cautiously to improve fuzzy search recall; monitor query latency and memory usage. Set to 0 to disable the limit entirely, but beware of unbounded result sets under high-cardinality patterns.
